critique.evidence: The oversized editorial headline, cyan/magenta accents, and “cached event replay” framing give the screen a recognizable lab-console identity. However, the main artifact is still a conventional transaction table plus detail pane, and the selected trace shows ALLOW versus ALLOW, so the promised “two very different answers” never becomes a memorable visual payoff. Mobile further reduces the concept to a long stack of compact records.
critique.fix: Make the selected trace visibly split into conflicting legacy and intent-integrity outcomes, then turn “inspect the causal seam” into the signature visual: an animated or diagrammatic payment replay that reveals exactly where the policies diverge. Preserve that side-by-side contrast on mobile instead of burying it below the event list.
